visual.displayName: Diverging Stacked Bar Chart by ChartExpo
visual.description: A custom Diverging Stacked Bar Chart visual for Power BI that displays data extending in opposite directions from a central baseline. Useful for visualizing survey results (like Likert scales), sentiment analysis, or comparing contrasting metrics across categories. Supports customizable bars, colors, tooltips, filters, slicers, and much more.
